== test/fixtures/v2/rim_glow.f3dmat
name RimGlow v2 material inputs [albedo, ambient, direct, emissive, indirect, lightmap, lit, nDotV, normal, occlusion, sceneDepth, viewDepth, world]
params [rimPower:float=[3.0], rimColor:vec3=[0.2, 0.5, 1.0] uniform MaterialParams, breath:float=[0.0] uniform MaterialParams]

fragment:
  let facing = call:clamp:float(input:nDotV:float, const:float[0.0], const:float[1.0])

  return binary:*:vec3(binary:*:vec3(input:albedo:vec3, binary:+:vec3(input:ambient:vec3, input:lightmap:vec3)), const:float[0.5])

  return binary:+:vec3(binary:*:vec3(binary:+:vec3(input:direct:vec3, input:indirect:vec3), input:occlusion:float), input:emissive:vec3)
--- glsl
#version 460 core

// Generated from a material written in the material language
// — gfx-84n. The source is the thing to edit; this file is
// what the shader build compiles and what the three GPU
// backends translate. The software backend evaluates the same
// tree instead of reading this.
#include <lib/material_maps.glsl>
#include <lib/shadow.glsl>

// The opaque scene's surface buffer: in a, its depth along
// the view axis in metres, nought where nothing was drawn.
uniform sampler2D scene_depth_texture;

uniform SceneDepthInfo {
  // xy: one over the target's size. z: its rows when row
  // zero is the bottom, nought when it is the top.
  vec4 target;
}
scene_depth_info;

uniform MaterialParams {
  vec3 rimColor;
  float breath;
}
material_params;

// The material's light block, run once per light.
vec3 ShadeLight(Surface s, LightSample light) {
  return s.albedo;
}

float LightVisibility(Surface s, LightSample light, int i) {
  return ShadowFactor(s, light, i);
}

// The material's ambient block: the light the surface takes
// from its surroundings, in place of the engine's own.
vec3 ShadeAmbient(Surface s, vec3 f3d_lightmap) {
  return ((s.albedo * (s.ambient + f3d_lightmap)) * 0.5);
}

// The material's composite block: how `lit` is added up.
vec3 ShadeComposite(Surface s, vec3 f3d_direct, vec3 f3d_indirect) {
  return (((f3d_direct + f3d_indirect) * s.occlusion) + s.emissive);
}

// `directional off`: every light the draw has but the
// directional ones, which always sit in its eight slots.
vec3 MaterialLights(Surface s) {
  vec3 total = vec3(0.0);
  int count = LightCount();
  for (int i = 0; i < kTotalLights; i++) {
    if (i >= count) break;
    if (i < kMaxLights && frag_info.light_position[i].w < 0.5) continue;
    LightSample light = SampleLight(i, s);
    if (light.n_dot_l <= 0.0) continue;
    light_transmittance = vec3(1.0);
    float visibility = LightHasShadow(i)
        ? LightVisibility(s, light, i) *
              PointShadowFactor(v_world_position, s.n, i)
        : 1.0;
    if (visibility <= 0.0) continue;
    total += ShadeLight(s, light) * light.radiance * light.n_dot_l * visibility * light_transmittance;
  }
  return total;
}

void main() {
  Surface s = ReadSurface();
  ApplyCommonMaps(s);
  vec3 f3d_direct = MaterialLights(s);
  vec3 f3d_lightmap = SampleLightmap();
  vec3 f3d_indirect = ShadeAmbient(s, f3d_lightmap);
  vec3 lit = ShadeComposite(s, f3d_direct, f3d_indirect);
  // Keeps what the engine binds to every lit stage; no frame
  // takes this branch.
  if (frag_info.frame_params.w < 0.0) {
    lit += f3d_direct + f3d_lightmap + s.ambient + s.emissive + vec3(s.occlusion);
  }
  float f3d_view_depth = ViewDepth();
  vec2 f3d_scene_uv = FragCoordFromTop(scene_depth_info.target.z) * scene_depth_info.target.xy;
  float f3d_stored = textureLod(scene_depth_texture, f3d_scene_uv, 0.0).a;
  float f3d_scene_depth = f3d_stored > 0.0 ? f3d_stored : 1000000.0;
  vec3 f3d_scene_position = Orthographic()
      ? v_world_position + fog_info.forward.xyz * (f3d_scene_depth - f3d_view_depth)
      : fog_info.eye.xyz + (v_world_position - fog_info.eye.xyz) * (f3d_scene_depth / max(f3d_view_depth, 1e-6));
  float facing = clamp(s.n_dot_v, 0.0, 1.0);
  float rim = pow((1.0 - facing), 3.0);
  float soft = clamp(((f3d_scene_depth - f3d_view_depth) * 4.0), 0.0, 1.0);
  vec4 result = vec4(((lit * (0.25 + (0.75 * facing))) + (material_params.rimColor * rim)), soft);
  WriteSurface(result.rgb, result.a);
}

--- vertex glsl
#version 460 core

// Generated from the vertex block of a material written in
// the material language, version 2. The source is the thing
// to edit. `mesh.vert` with the
// block between the engine's answer and the varyings.

in vec3 position;
in vec3 normal;
in vec2 texcoord;
in vec4 tangent;
in vec4 color;

#include <lib/morph.glsl>

uniform FrameInfo {
  mat4 mvp;
  mat4 model;
  mat4 normal_matrix;
}
frame_info;

// The view-projection alone, for a block that says where in
// the world the vertex is rather than where in the mesh.
uniform MaterialVertexInfo {
  mat4 view_projection;
}
material_vertex_info;

uniform MaterialParams {
  vec3 rimColor;
  float breath;
}
material_params;

out vec3 v_world_position;
out vec3 v_normal;
out vec2 v_texcoord;
out vec4 v_tangent;
out vec4 v_color;
out vec2 v_lightmap_uv;
out vec4 v_instance;

void main() {
  vec3 morphed_position = position;
  vec3 morphed_normal = normal;
  vec4 morphed_tangent = tangent;
  ApplyMorph(morphed_position, morphed_normal, morphed_tangent);
  vec3 f3d_position = morphed_position;
  vec3 f3d_object_normal = morphed_normal;
  vec3 f3d_tangent = morphed_tangent.xyz;
  bool f3d_mirrored = determinant(mat3(frame_info.model)) < 0.0;
  vec3 f3d_world = (frame_info.model * vec4(f3d_position, 1.0)).xyz;
  vec3 f3d_normal = mat3(frame_info.normal_matrix) * f3d_object_normal;
  vec3 f3d_out_position = f3d_position;
  vec3 f3d_out_world = f3d_world;
  vec3 f3d_out_normal = f3d_normal;

  // The material's vertex block.
  f3d_out_world = (f3d_world + (f3d_normal * (0.02 * material_params.breath)));

  v_world_position = f3d_out_world;
  v_normal = f3d_out_normal;
  v_texcoord = texcoord;
  v_tangent = vec4(mat3(frame_info.model) * f3d_tangent,
                   f3d_mirrored ? -morphed_tangent.w : morphed_tangent.w);
  v_color = color;
  v_lightmap_uv = vec2(0.0);
  v_instance = vec4(0.0);
  gl_Position = material_vertex_info.view_projection * vec4(f3d_out_world, 1.0);
}

#version 460 core

// Generated from a material written in the material language
// — gfx-84n. The source is the thing to edit; this file is
// what the shader build compiles and what the three GPU
// backends translate. The software backend evaluates the same
// tree instead of reading this.
#define F3D_NO_POINT_SHADOW
#define F3D_NO_LIGHT_LIST
#include <lib/surface.glsl>

in vec4 v_instance;

// Never called: this material returns the light its surface
// emits rather than gathering any. The prototypes in
// surface.glsl still have to be satisfied.
vec3 ShadeLight(Surface s, LightSample light) {
  return s.albedo;
}

float LightVisibility(Surface s, LightSample light, int i) {
  return 1.0;
}

void main() {
  Surface s = ReadSurface();
  float facing = clamp(s.n_dot_v, 0.0, 1.0);
  float rim = (pow((1.0 - facing), 3.0) * v_instance.w);
  vec4 result = vec4(((v_instance.xyz * (0.25 + (0.75 * facing))) + vec3(rim, rim, rim)), 1.0);
  WriteSurface(result.rgb, result.a);
}

  return binary:/:vec3(binary:*:vec3(binary:*:vec3(input:albedo:vec3, param:paint:vec3), local:banded:float), call:max:float(input:nDotL:float, const:float[0.001]))
--- glsl
#version 460 core

// Generated from a material written in the material language
// — gfx-84n. The source is the thing to edit; this file is
// what the shader build compiles and what the three GPU
// backends translate. The software backend evaluates the same
// tree instead of reading this.
#include <lib/material_maps.glsl>
#include <lib/shadow.glsl>

uniform MaterialParams {
  vec3 paint;
  vec3 rimColor;
}
material_params;

// The material's light block, run once per light.
vec3 ShadeLight(Surface s, LightSample light) {
  float banded = (floor(((light.n_dot_l * 3.0) + 0.5)) / 3.0);
  return (((s.albedo * material_params.paint) * banded) / max(light.n_dot_l, 0.001));
}

float LightVisibility(Surface s, LightSample light, int i) {
  return ShadowFactor(s, light, i);
}

void main() {
  Surface s = ReadSurface();
  ApplyCommonMaps(s);
  vec3 lit = AccumulateLights(s) * s.occlusion + s.albedo * (s.ambient + SampleLightmap()) * s.occlusion + s.emissive;
  float rim = pow((1.0 - clamp(s.n_dot_v, 0.0, 1.0)), 4.0);
  vec4 result = vec4((lit + ((material_params.rimColor * rim) * 0.5)), 1.0);
  WriteSurface(result.rgb, result.a);
}

  let glassy = binary:+:vec3(binary:*:vec3(local:sheetSky:vec3, local:sheetFresnel:float), binary:*:vec3(binary:*:vec3(param:scatter:vec3, local:sheetLit:vec3), binary:-:float(const:float[1.0], local:sheetFresnel:float)))
  let clear = call:smoothstep:float(const:float[0.0], const:float[0.5], call:dot:float(call:pow:vec3(const:vec3[0.3679, 0.3679, 0.3679], binary:*:vec3(param:absorb:vec3, const:float[0.05])), const:vec3[0.3333, 0.3333, 0.3333]))
  let spume = call:mix:vec3(binary:*:vec3(param:scatter:vec3, local:sheetLit:vec3), binary:*:vec3(const:vec3[0.93, 0.96, 0.98], binary:+:vec3(local:sheetLit:vec3, binary:*:vec3(param:sunColor:vec3, const:float[0.2]))), local:clear:float)
  let sheetColour = binary:+:vec3(call:mix:vec3(local:glassy:vec3, local:spume:vec3, local:aerated:float), binary:*:vec3(param:glow:vec3, binary:+:float(const:float[0.5], binary:*:float(const:float[0.5], local:fibre:float))))
  let shreds = binary:+:float(const:float[0.5], binary:*:float(const:float[0.5], call:sin:float(binary:+:float(binary:+:float(binary:*:float(const:float[31.0], local:along:float), binary:*:float(const:float[3.0], call:sin:float(binary:+:float(binary:*:float(const:float[7.1], local:along:float), binary:*:float(const:float[2.0], local:left:float))))), binary:*:float(const:float[9.0], local:left:float)))))
  let fray = local:fallen:float
  let torn = call:mix:float(const:float[1.0], call:smoothstep:float(binary:-:float(binary:*:float(const:float[1.1], local:fray:float), const:float[0.15]), binary:+:float(binary:*:float(const:float[1.1], local:fray:float), const:float[0.1]), binary:+:float(binary:*:float(const:float[0.6], local:fibre:float), binary:*:float(const:float[0.4], local:shreds:float))), local:fray:float)
  let sheetBody = call:mix:float(call:mix:float(binary:+:float(const:float[0.12], binary:*:float(const:float[0.45], local:sheetFresnel:float)), const:float[0.9], local:aerated:float), const:float[0.97], binary:-:float(const:float[1.0], local:clear:float))
  let sheetSeen = binary:*:float(binary:*:float(input:alpha:float, local:sheetBody:float), local:torn:float)
  let facingCloud = call:clamp:float(call:abs:float(call:dot:float(input:normal:vec3, input:view:vec3)), const:float[0.0], const:float[1.0])
  let off2 = binary:-:float(const:float[1.0], binary:*:float(local:facingCloud:float, local:facingCloud:float))
  let mistSeen = binary:-:float(const:float[1.0], call:pow:float(const:float[0.3679], binary:*:float(call:max:float(swizzle:float[0](input:instance:vec4), const:float[0.0]), call:pow:float(const:float[0.3679], binary:*:float(binary:*:float(binary:*:float(const:float[0.5], swizzle:float[1](input:instance:vec4)), swizzle:float[1](input:instance:vec4)), local:off2:float)))))
  let mistColour = binary:*:vec3(const:vec3[0.92, 0.95, 0.98], binary:+:vec3(input:ambient:vec3, binary:*:vec3(param:sunColor:vec3, const:float[0.45])))
  let isSheet = call:step:float(const:float[0.5], swizzle:float[1](input:uv:vec2))
  let isMist = call:step:float(const:float[0.5], swizzle:float[3](input:instance:vec4))
  return construct:vec4(call:mix:vec3(call:mix:vec3(local:surfaceColour:vec3, local:sheetColour:vec3, local:isSheet:float), local:mistColour:vec3, local:isMist:float), call:mix:float(call:mix:float(local:surfaceSeen:float, local:sheetSeen:float, local:isSheet:float), local:mistSeen:float, local:isMist:float))
light:
  return const:vec3[1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
--- glsl
#version 460 core

// Generated from a material written in the material language
// — gfx-84n. The source is the thing to edit; this file is
// what the shader build compiles and what the three GPU
// backends translate. The software backend evaluates the same
// tree instead of reading this.
#include <lib/material_maps.glsl>
#include <lib/shadow.glsl>

in vec4 v_instance;

uniform MaterialParams {
  float time;
  float chop;
  vec3 eye;
  float pixel;
  vec3 toSun;
  vec3 sunColor;
  vec3 zenith;
  vec3 horizon;
  vec3 absorb;
  vec3 scatter;
  vec3 glow;
}
material_params;

// The material's light block, run once per light.
vec3 ShadeLight(Surface s, LightSample light) {
  return vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
}

float LightVisibility(Surface s, LightSample light, int i) {
  return ShadowFactor(s, light, i);
}

void main() {
  Surface s = ReadSurface();
  ApplyCommonMaps(s);
  vec3 lit = AccumulateLights(s) * s.occlusion + s.albedo * (s.ambient + SampleLightmap()) * s.occlusion + s.emissive;
  float depth = max(v_texcoord.x, 0.0);
  vec2 flow = ((s.albedo.xy - vec2(0.5, 0.5)) * 8.0);
  vec2 here = v_world_position.xz;
  float cycle = 2.5;
  float a = fract((material_params.time / cycle));
  float b = fract(((material_params.time / cycle) + 0.5));
  float onB = abs(((2.0 * a) - 1.0));
  vec2 qa = (here - (flow * (a * cycle)));
  vec2 qb = (here - (flow * (b * cycle)));
  float far = max(length((v_world_position - material_params.eye)), 0.001);
  float px = (1.0 / (far * material_params.pixel));
  float reach = (material_params.chop * (0.3 + (0.7 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.2, depth))));
  float gust = (0.7 + ((0.3 * sin((((0.31 * here.x) + (0.17 * here.y)) + (0.23 * material_params.time)))) * sin((((0.19 * here.y) - (0.27 * here.x)) - (0.11 * material_params.time)))));
  vec2 d1 = vec2(0.94, 0.342);
  vec2 d2 = vec2(0.857, -0.515);
  vec2 d3 = vec2(0.438, 0.899);
  vec2 d4 = vec2(0.999, 0.035);
  vec2 d5 = vec2(-0.358, 0.934);
  vec2 d6 = vec2(0.53, -0.848);
  vec2 d7 = vec2(-0.883, 0.469);
  vec2 d8 = vec2(0.799, 0.602);
  vec2 d9 = vec2(-0.515, -0.857);
  float s1 = ((0.032 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (3.0952 * px)));
  float s2 = ((0.032 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (2.1666 * px)));
  float s3 = ((0.03 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (1.5288 * px)));
  float s4 = ((0.029 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (1.1301 * px)));
  float s5 = (((0.028 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (0.83 * px))) * gust);
  float s6 = (((0.027 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (0.5973 * px))) * gust);
  float s7 = (((0.026 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (0.4369 * px))) * gust);
  float s8 = (((0.026 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (0.318 * px))) * gust);
  float s9 = (((0.024 * reach) * smoothstep(2.0, 4.0, (0.231 * px))) * gust);
  vec2 ba = (qa + vec2(((0.25 * sin(((0.73 * qa.y) + (0.4 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((2.11 * qa.y) - (0.9 * qa.x)) + (0.7 * material_params.time))))), ((0.25 * sin(((0.61 * qa.x) - (0.3 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((1.87 * qa.x) + (0.8 * qa.y)) - (0.6 * material_params.time)))))));
  vec2 bb = (qb + vec2(((0.25 * sin(((0.73 * qb.y) + (0.4 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((2.11 * qb.y) - (0.9 * qb.x)) + (0.7 * material_params.time))))), ((0.25 * sin(((0.61 * qb.x) - (0.3 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((1.87 * qb.x) + (0.8 * qb.y)) - (0.6 * material_params.time)))))));
  vec2 ga = (((((((((d1 * (s1 * cos(((2.03 * dot(d1, ba)) - (4.46 * material_params.time))))) + (d2 * (s2 * cos(((2.9 * dot(d2, ba)) - (5.33 * material_params.time)))))) + (d3 * (s3 * cos(((4.11 * dot(d3, ba)) - (6.35 * material_params.time)))))) + (d4 * (s4 * cos(((5.56 * dot(d4, ba)) - (7.39 * material_params.time)))))) + (d5 * (s5 * cos(((7.57 * dot(d5, ba)) - (8.62 * material_params.time)))))) + (d6 * (s6 * cos(((10.52 * dot(d6, ba)) - (10.16 * material_params.time)))))) + (d7 * (s7 * cos(((14.38 * dot(d7, ba)) - (11.88 * material_params.time)))))) + (d8 * (s8 * cos(((19.76 * dot(d8, ba)) - (13.92 * material_params.time)))))) + (d9 * (s9 * cos(((27.2 * dot(d9, ba)) - (16.33 * material_params.time))))));
  vec2 gb = (((((((((d1 * (s1 * cos(((2.03 * dot(d1, bb)) - (4.46 * material_params.time))))) + (d2 * (s2 * cos(((2.9 * dot(d2, bb)) - (5.33 * material_params.time)))))) + (d3 * (s3 * cos(((4.11 * dot(d3, bb)) - (6.35 * material_params.time)))))) + (d4 * (s4 * cos(((5.56 * dot(d4, bb)) - (7.39 * material_params.time)))))) + (d5 * (s5 * cos(((7.57 * dot(d5, bb)) - (8.62 * material_params.time)))))) + (d6 * (s6 * cos(((10.52 * dot(d6, bb)) - (10.16 * material_params.time)))))) + (d7 * (s7 * cos(((14.38 * dot(d7, bb)) - (11.88 * material_params.time)))))) + (d8 * (s8 * cos(((19.76 * dot(d8, bb)) - (13.92 * material_params.time)))))) + (d9 * (s9 * cos(((27.2 * dot(d9, bb)) - (16.33 * material_params.time))))));
  vec2 slope = mix(ga, gb, vec2(onB));
  vec3 n = normalize((s.n + vec3((0.0 - slope.x), 0.0, (0.0 - slope.y))));
  float facing = clamp(dot(n, s.v), 0.0, 1.0);
  float fresnel = (0.02 + (0.98 * pow((1.0 - facing), 5.0)));
  vec3 mirrored = ((n * (2.0 * dot(n, s.v))) - s.v);
  float rise = clamp(mirrored.y, 0.0, 1.0);
  vec3 sky = mix(material_params.horizon, material_params.zenith, vec3((rise * (2.0 - rise))));
  float toward = clamp(dot(mirrored, material_params.toSun), 0.0, 1.0);
  float sunOn = clamp(dot(n, material_params.toSun), 0.0, 1.0);
  float sunlit = clamp((dot(lit, vec3(0.3333, 0.3333, 0.3333)) / max((dot(material_params.sunColor, vec3(0.3333, 0.3333, 0.3333)) * sunOn), 0.0001)), 0.0, 1.0);
  vec3 glint = ((material_params.sunColor * sunlit) * (((fresnel * 30.0) * pow(toward, 1200.0)) + (0.03 * pow(toward, 60.0))));
  float cosDown = sqrt(max((1.0 - ((1.0 - (facing * facing)) * 0.5652)), 0.0));
  float path = (depth / max(cosDown, 0.3));
  vec3 throughRgb = pow(vec3(0.3679, 0.3679, 0.3679), (material_params.absorb * path));
  float through = dot(throughRgb, vec3(0.3333, 0.3333, 0.3333));
  vec3 inscatter = (((material_params.scatter * (vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) - throughRgb)) * (s.ambient + lit)) * (1.0 / max((1.0 - through), 0.001)));
  float crust = (0.25 + (0.75 * clamp((3.0 * length(flow)), 0.0, 1.0)));
  float veil = max((1.0 - ((1.0 - fresnel) * through)), 0.001);
  vec3 water = (((((sky * fresnel) + (inscatter * ((1.0 - fresnel) * (1.0 - through)))) + glint) + (material_params.glow * crust)) * (1.0 / veil));
  vec2 foamFlow = (flow * (1.0 / max(length(flow), 1.0)));
  vec2 fa = (here - (foamFlow * (a * cycle)));
  vec2 fb = (here - (foamFlow * (b * cycle)));
  float laceA = (((0.55 * sin(((9.7 * fa.x) + (1.9 * sin(((6.1 * fa.y) + (1.3 * fa.x))))))) * sin(((8.3 * fa.y) + (1.6 * sin(((5.9 * fa.x) - (1.1 * fa.y))))))) + (0.45 * sin((((3.1 * fa.x) - (2.6 * fa.y)) + (1.4 * sin((2.3 * fa.y)))))));
  float laceB = (((0.55 * sin(((9.7 * fb.x) + (1.9 * sin(((6.1 * fb.y) + (1.3 * fb.x))))))) * sin(((8.3 * fb.y) + (1.6 * sin(((5.9 * fb.x) - (1.1 * fb.y))))))) + (0.45 * sin((((3.1 * fb.x) - (2.6 * fb.y)) + (1.4 * sin((2.3 * fb.y)))))));
  float lace = (0.5 + (0.5 * mix(laceA, laceB, onB)));
  float speed = length(flow);
  float breaking = ((0.5 * smoothstep(2.2, 3.9, speed)) * smoothstep(0.03, 0.1, depth));
  float churn = clamp((s.albedo.z + breaking), 0.0, 1.0);
  float froth = smoothstep(0.4, 1.0, (churn * (0.3 + (0.9 * lace))));
  vec3 white = (vec3(0.92, 0.95, 0.97) * (s.ambient + (0.45 * lit)));
  vec3 above = mix(water, white, vec3(froth));
  float aboveSeen = mix(veil, 1.0, froth);
  float waver = (sin(((3.1 * here.x) + (1.7 * sin((2.3 * here.y))))) * sin(((2.7 * here.y) + (1.9 * sin((1.3 * here.x))))));
  float edge = smoothstep(0.0, 0.06, (v_texcoord.x + (0.01 * waver)));
  float under = (1.0 - step(0.0, dot(s.n, s.v)));
  vec3 up = (n * ((2.0 * step(0.0, n.y)) - 1.0));
  vec3 rayUp = (vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) - s.v);
  float cosIn = clamp(dot(rayUp, up), 0.0, 1.0);
  float ior = 1.33;
  float sinOut2 = ((ior * ior) * (1.0 - (cosIn * cosIn)));
  float window = (1.0 - step(1.0, sinOut2));
  float cosOut = sqrt(max((1.0 - sinOut2), 0.0));
  vec3 outward = normalize(((rayUp * ior) + (up * (cosOut - (ior * cosIn)))));
  vec3 skyThrough = mix(material_params.horizon, material_params.zenith, vec3(sqrt(clamp(outward.y, 0.0, 1.0))));
  vec3 sunThrough = (material_params.sunColor * (6.0 * pow(clamp(dot(outward, material_params.toSun), 0.0, 1.0), 400.0)));
  float leaving = (0.02 + (0.98 * pow((1.0 - cosOut), 5.0)));
  vec3 mirrorBelow = (material_params.scatter * s.ambient);
  vec3 below = mix(mirrorBelow, (((skyThrough + sunThrough) * (1.0 - leaving)) + (mirrorBelow * leaving)), vec3(window));
  vec3 surfaceColour = mix(above, below, vec3(under));
  float surfaceSeen = (mix(aboveSeen, 1.0, under) * edge);
  float down = max((v_texcoord.y - 1.0), 0.0);
  float fallen = clamp(s.albedo.x, 0.0, 1.0);
  float thick = s.albedo.y;
  float along = v_texcoord.x;
  float left = (material_params.time - sqrt((0.204 * down)));
  float lanes = (0.5 + (0.5 * sin((((13.3 * along) + (1.7 * sin(((4.9 * along) + (0.8 * left))))) + (0.9 * sin((1.1 * left)))))));
  float strands = (0.5 + (0.5 * sin(((37.1 * along) + (2.3 * sin(((9.7 * along) - (1.4 * left))))))));
  float pulse = (0.5 + (0.5 * sin(((13.0 * left) + (2.1 * sin((3.7 * along)))))));
  float fibre = (((0.5 * lanes) + (0.3 * strands)) + (0.2 * pulse));
  float aerated = clamp((smoothstep(0.1, 1.8, (down + ((0.6 * thick) * down))) * smoothstep(0.2, 0.7, (fibre + (0.25 * smoothstep(1.0, 3.0, down))))), 0.0, 1.0);
  float facesEye = ((2.0 * step(0.0, dot(s.n, s.v))) - 1.0);
  vec3 sn = (s.n * facesEye);
  float sheetFacing = clamp(dot(sn, s.v), 0.0, 1.0);
  float sheetFresnel = (0.02 + (0.98 * pow((1.0 - sheetFacing), 5.0)));
  vec3 sheetMirrored = ((sn * (2.0 * dot(sn, s.v))) - s.v);
  float sheetRise = clamp(sheetMirrored.y, 0.0, 1.0);
  vec3 sheetSky = mix(material_params.horizon, material_params.zenith, vec3((sheetRise * (2.0 - sheetRise))));
  vec3 sheetLit = (s.ambient + (material_params.sunColor * (0.3 + (0.3 * abs(dot(sn, material_params.toSun))))));
  vec3 glassy = ((sheetSky * sheetFresnel) + ((material_params.scatter * sheetLit) * (1.0 - sheetFresnel)));
  float clear = smoothstep(0.0, 0.5, dot(pow(vec3(0.3679, 0.3679, 0.3679), (material_params.absorb * 0.05)), vec3(0.3333, 0.3333, 0.3333)));
  vec3 spume = mix((material_params.scatter * sheetLit), (vec3(0.93, 0.96, 0.98) * (sheetLit + (material_params.sunColor * 0.2))), vec3(clear));
  vec3 sheetColour = (mix(glassy, spume, vec3(aerated)) + (material_params.glow * (0.5 + (0.5 * fibre))));
  float shreds = (0.5 + (0.5 * sin((((31.0 * along) + (3.0 * sin(((7.1 * along) + (2.0 * left))))) + (9.0 * left)))));
  float fray = fallen;
  float torn = mix(1.0, smoothstep(((1.1 * fray) - 0.15), ((1.1 * fray) + 0.1), ((0.6 * fibre) + (0.4 * shreds))), fray);
  float sheetBody = mix(mix((0.12 + (0.45 * sheetFresnel)), 0.9, aerated), 0.97, (1.0 - clear));
  float sheetSeen = ((s.alpha * sheetBody) * torn);
  float facingCloud = clamp(abs(dot(s.n, s.v)), 0.0, 1.0);
  float off2 = (1.0 - (facingCloud * facingCloud));
  float mistSeen = (1.0 - pow(0.3679, (max(v_instance.x, 0.0) * pow(0.3679, (((0.5 * v_instance.y) * v_instance.y) * off2)))));
  vec3 mistColour = (vec3(0.92, 0.95, 0.98) * (s.ambient + (material_params.sunColor * 0.45)));
  float isSheet = step(0.5, v_texcoord.y);
  float isMist = step(0.5, v_instance.w);
  vec4 result = vec4(mix(mix(surfaceColour, sheetColour, vec3(isSheet)), mistColour, vec3(isMist)), mix(mix(surfaceSeen, sheetSeen, isSheet), mistSeen, isMist));
  WriteSurface(result.rgb, result.a);
}

  let hxz = binary:+:float(binary:+:float(binary:+:float(binary:+:float(binary:+:float(binary:+:float(binary:+:float(binary:+:float(binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c1:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d1:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d1:vec2)), binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c2:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d2:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d2:vec2))), binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c3:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d3:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d3:vec2))), binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c4:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d4:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d4:vec2))), binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c5:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d5:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d5:vec2))), binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c6:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d6:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d6:vec2))), binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c7:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d7:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d7:vec2))), binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c8:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d8:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d8:vec2))), binary:*:float(binary:*:float(local:c9:float, swizzle:float[0](local:d9:vec2)), swizzle:float[1](local:d9:vec2)))

  let focus = call:min:float(binary:/:float(const:float[1.0], call:max:float(call:abs:float(local:det:float), const:float[0.12])), const:float[6.0])

#version 460 core

// Generated from a material written in the material language
// — gfx-84n. The source is the thing to edit; this file is
// what the shader build compiles and what the three GPU
// backends translate. The software backend evaluates the same
// tree instead of reading this.
#include <lib/material_maps.glsl>
#include <lib/shadow.glsl>

uniform MaterialParams {
  float time;
  float chop;
  vec3 eye;
  float level;
  vec3 toSun;
  vec3 sunColor;
  vec3 absorb;
  vec3 scatter;
}
material_params;

// The material's light block, run once per light.
vec3 ShadeLight(Surface s, LightSample light) {
  vec2 here = v_world_position.xz;
  float depth = max((material_params.level - v_world_position.y), 0.0);
  float ior = 1.33;
  float bend = (depth * (1.0 - (1.0 / ior)));
  float cosDown = sqrt((1.0 - ((1.0 - (material_params.toSun.y * material_params.toSun.y)) / (ior * ior))));
  vec2 sunDown = (vec2(material_params.toSun.x, material_params.toSun.z) * ((1.0 / ior) / cosDown));
  vec2 start = (here + (sunDown * depth));
  float blurWidth = (0.00175 * depth);
  float gust = (0.7 + ((0.3 * sin((((0.31 * start.x) + (0.17 * start.y)) + (0.23 * material_params.time)))) * sin((((0.19 * start.y) - (0.27 * start.x)) - (0.11 * material_params.time)))));
  vec2 d1 = vec2(0.94, 0.342);
  float s1 = ((0.032 * material_params.chop) * pow(0.60653, ((2.03 * blurWidth) * (2.03 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 d2 = vec2(0.857, -0.515);
  float s2 = ((0.032 * material_params.chop) * pow(0.60653, ((2.9 * blurWidth) * (2.9 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 d3 = vec2(0.438, 0.899);
  float s3 = ((0.03 * material_params.chop) * pow(0.60653, ((4.11 * blurWidth) * (4.11 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 d4 = vec2(0.999, 0.035);
  float s4 = ((0.029 * material_params.chop) * pow(0.60653, ((5.56 * blurWidth) * (5.56 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 d5 = vec2(-0.358, 0.934);
  float s5 = (((0.028 * material_params.chop) * gust) * pow(0.60653, ((7.57 * blurWidth) * (7.57 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 d6 = vec2(0.53, -0.848);
  float s6 = (((0.027 * material_params.chop) * gust) * pow(0.60653, ((10.52 * blurWidth) * (10.52 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 d7 = vec2(-0.883, 0.469);
  float s7 = (((0.026 * material_params.chop) * gust) * pow(0.60653, ((14.38 * blurWidth) * (14.38 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 d8 = vec2(0.799, 0.602);
  float s8 = (((0.026 * material_params.chop) * gust) * pow(0.60653, ((19.76 * blurWidth) * (19.76 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 d9 = vec2(-0.515, -0.857);
  float s9 = (((0.024 * material_params.chop) * gust) * pow(0.60653, ((27.2 * blurWidth) * (27.2 * blurWidth))));
  vec2 b0 = (start + vec2(((0.25 * sin(((0.73 * start.y) + (0.4 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((2.11 * start.y) - (0.9 * start.x)) + (0.7 * material_params.time))))), ((0.25 * sin(((0.61 * start.x) - (0.3 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((1.87 * start.x) + (0.8 * start.y)) - (0.6 * material_params.time)))))));
  vec2 g0 = (((((((((d1 * (s1 * cos(((2.03 * dot(d1, b0)) - (4.46 * material_params.time))))) + (d2 * (s2 * cos(((2.9 * dot(d2, b0)) - (5.33 * material_params.time)))))) + (d3 * (s3 * cos(((4.11 * dot(d3, b0)) - (6.35 * material_params.time)))))) + (d4 * (s4 * cos(((5.56 * dot(d4, b0)) - (7.39 * material_params.time)))))) + (d5 * (s5 * cos(((7.57 * dot(d5, b0)) - (8.62 * material_params.time)))))) + (d6 * (s6 * cos(((10.52 * dot(d6, b0)) - (10.16 * material_params.time)))))) + (d7 * (s7 * cos(((14.38 * dot(d7, b0)) - (11.88 * material_params.time)))))) + (d8 * (s8 * cos(((19.76 * dot(d8, b0)) - (13.92 * material_params.time)))))) + (d9 * (s9 * cos(((27.2 * dot(d9, b0)) - (16.33 * material_params.time))))));
  vec2 x1 = (start - (g0 * bend));
  vec2 b1 = (x1 + vec2(((0.25 * sin(((0.73 * x1.y) + (0.4 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((2.11 * x1.y) - (0.9 * x1.x)) + (0.7 * material_params.time))))), ((0.25 * sin(((0.61 * x1.x) - (0.3 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((1.87 * x1.x) + (0.8 * x1.y)) - (0.6 * material_params.time)))))));
  vec2 g1 = (((((((((d1 * (s1 * cos(((2.03 * dot(d1, b1)) - (4.46 * material_params.time))))) + (d2 * (s2 * cos(((2.9 * dot(d2, b1)) - (5.33 * material_params.time)))))) + (d3 * (s3 * cos(((4.11 * dot(d3, b1)) - (6.35 * material_params.time)))))) + (d4 * (s4 * cos(((5.56 * dot(d4, b1)) - (7.39 * material_params.time)))))) + (d5 * (s5 * cos(((7.57 * dot(d5, b1)) - (8.62 * material_params.time)))))) + (d6 * (s6 * cos(((10.52 * dot(d6, b1)) - (10.16 * material_params.time)))))) + (d7 * (s7 * cos(((14.38 * dot(d7, b1)) - (11.88 * material_params.time)))))) + (d8 * (s8 * cos(((19.76 * dot(d8, b1)) - (13.92 * material_params.time)))))) + (d9 * (s9 * cos(((27.2 * dot(d9, b1)) - (16.33 * material_params.time))))));
  vec2 x2 = (start - (g1 * bend));
  vec2 b2 = (x2 + vec2(((0.25 * sin(((0.73 * x2.y) + (0.4 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((2.11 * x2.y) - (0.9 * x2.x)) + (0.7 * material_params.time))))), ((0.25 * sin(((0.61 * x2.x) - (0.3 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((1.87 * x2.x) + (0.8 * x2.y)) - (0.6 * material_params.time)))))));
  vec2 g2 = (((((((((d1 * (s1 * cos(((2.03 * dot(d1, b2)) - (4.46 * material_params.time))))) + (d2 * (s2 * cos(((2.9 * dot(d2, b2)) - (5.33 * material_params.time)))))) + (d3 * (s3 * cos(((4.11 * dot(d3, b2)) - (6.35 * material_params.time)))))) + (d4 * (s4 * cos(((5.56 * dot(d4, b2)) - (7.39 * material_params.time)))))) + (d5 * (s5 * cos(((7.57 * dot(d5, b2)) - (8.62 * material_params.time)))))) + (d6 * (s6 * cos(((10.52 * dot(d6, b2)) - (10.16 * material_params.time)))))) + (d7 * (s7 * cos(((14.38 * dot(d7, b2)) - (11.88 * material_params.time)))))) + (d8 * (s8 * cos(((19.76 * dot(d8, b2)) - (13.92 * material_params.time)))))) + (d9 * (s9 * cos(((27.2 * dot(d9, b2)) - (16.33 * material_params.time))))));
  vec2 at = (start - (g2 * bend));
  vec2 bat = (at + vec2(((0.25 * sin(((0.73 * at.y) + (0.4 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((2.11 * at.y) - (0.9 * at.x)) + (0.7 * material_params.time))))), ((0.25 * sin(((0.61 * at.x) - (0.3 * material_params.time)))) + (0.08 * sin((((1.87 * at.x) + (0.8 * at.y)) - (0.6 * material_params.time)))))));
  float c1 = (0.0 - ((s1 * 2.03) * sin(((2.03 * dot(d1, bat)) - (4.46 * material_params.time)))));
  float c2 = (0.0 - ((s2 * 2.9) * sin(((2.9 * dot(d2, bat)) - (5.33 * material_params.time)))));
  float c3 = (0.0 - ((s3 * 4.11) * sin(((4.11 * dot(d3, bat)) - (6.35 * material_params.time)))));
  float c4 = (0.0 - ((s4 * 5.56) * sin(((5.56 * dot(d4, bat)) - (7.39 * material_params.time)))));
  float c5 = (0.0 - ((s5 * 7.57) * sin(((7.57 * dot(d5, bat)) - (8.62 * material_params.time)))));
  float c6 = (0.0 - ((s6 * 10.52) * sin(((10.52 * dot(d6, bat)) - (10.16 * material_params.time)))));
  float c7 = (0.0 - ((s7 * 14.38) * sin(((14.38 * dot(d7, bat)) - (11.88 * material_params.time)))));
  float c8 = (0.0 - ((s8 * 19.76) * sin(((19.76 * dot(d8, bat)) - (13.92 * material_params.time)))));
  float c9 = (0.0 - ((s9 * 27.2) * sin(((27.2 * dot(d9, bat)) - (16.33 * material_params.time)))));
  float hxx = ((((((((((c1 * d1.x) * d1.x) + ((c2 * d2.x) * d2.x)) + ((c3 * d3.x) * d3.x)) + ((c4 * d4.x) * d4.x)) + ((c5 * d5.x) * d5.x)) + ((c6 * d6.x) * d6.x)) + ((c7 * d7.x) * d7.x)) + ((c8 * d8.x) * d8.x)) + ((c9 * d9.x) * d9.x));
  float hzz = ((((((((((c1 * d1.y) * d1.y) + ((c2 * d2.y) * d2.y)) + ((c3 * d3.y) * d3.y)) + ((c4 * d4.y) * d4.y)) + ((c5 * d5.y) * d5.y)) + ((c6 * d6.y) * d6.y)) + ((c7 * d7.y) * d7.y)) + ((c8 * d8.y) * d8.y)) + ((c9 * d9.y) * d9.y));
  float hxz = ((((((((((c1 * d1.x) * d1.y) + ((c2 * d2.x) * d2.y)) + ((c3 * d3.x) * d3.y)) + ((c4 * d4.x) * d4.y)) + ((c5 * d5.x) * d5.y)) + ((c6 * d6.x) * d6.y)) + ((c7 * d7.x) * d7.y)) + ((c8 * d8.x) * d8.y)) + ((c9 * d9.x) * d9.y));
  float det = (((1.0 + (bend * hxx)) * (1.0 + (bend * hzz))) - (((bend * bend) * hxz) * hxz));
  float focus = min((1.0 / max(abs(det), 0.12)), 6.0);
  vec3 throughDown = pow(vec3(0.3679, 0.3679, 0.3679), (material_params.absorb * (depth / cosDown)));
  return ((s.albedo * focus) * throughDown);
}

float LightVisibility(Surface s, LightSample light, int i) {
  return ShadowFactor(s, light, i);
}

void main() {
  Surface s = ReadSurface();
  ApplyCommonMaps(s);
  vec3 lit = AccumulateLights(s) * s.occlusion + s.albedo * (s.ambient + SampleLightmap()) * s.occlusion + s.emissive;
  float depth = max((material_params.level - v_world_position.y), 0.0);
  float ior = 1.33;
  float cosDown = sqrt((1.0 - ((1.0 - (material_params.toSun.y * material_params.toSun.y)) / (ior * ior))));
  vec3 throughDown = pow(vec3(0.3679, 0.3679, 0.3679), (material_params.absorb * (depth / cosDown)));
  float toEye = length((material_params.eye - v_world_position));
  float eyeDepth = max((material_params.level - material_params.eye.y), 0.0);
  float path = mix(((depth * toEye) / max((depth + max((material_params.eye.y - material_params.level), 0.0)), 0.001)), toEye, step(0.0, (eyeDepth - 0.001)));
  vec3 throughUp = pow(vec3(0.3679, 0.3679, 0.3679), (material_params.absorb * path));
  vec3 sunLit = max(((lit - s.emissive) - ((s.albedo * s.ambient) * s.occlusion)), vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
  vec3 floorLit = (sunLit + (((s.albedo * s.ambient) * s.occlusion) * throughDown));
  vec3 back = (material_params.scatter * ((material_params.sunColor * throughDown) + s.ambient));
  vec4 result = vec4(((floorLit * throughUp) + (back * (vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) - throughUp))), 1.0);
  WriteSurface(result.rgb, result.a);
}

#version 460 core

// Generated from a material written in the material language
// — gfx-84n. The source is the thing to edit; this file is
// what the shader build compiles and what the three GPU
// backends translate. The software backend evaluates the same
// tree instead of reading this.
#include <lib/material_maps.glsl>
#include <lib/shadow.glsl>

// The opaque scene's surface buffer: in a, its depth along
// the view axis in metres, nought where nothing was drawn.
uniform sampler2D scene_depth_texture;

uniform SceneDepthInfo {
  // xy: one over the target's size. z: its rows when row
  // zero is the bottom, nought when it is the top.
  vec4 target;
}
scene_depth_info;

uniform MaterialParams {
  vec3 rimColor;
  float breath;
}
material_params;

// The material's light block, run once per light.
vec3 ShadeLight(Surface s, LightSample light) {
  return s.albedo;
}

float LightVisibility(Surface s, LightSample light, int i) {
  return ShadowFactor(s, light, i);
}

// The material's ambient block: the light the surface takes
// from its surroundings, in place of the engine's own.
vec3 ShadeAmbient(Surface s, vec3 f3d_lightmap) {
  return ((s.albedo * (s.ambient + f3d_lightmap)) * 0.5);
}

// The material's composite block: how `lit` is added up.
vec3 ShadeComposite(Surface s, vec3 f3d_direct, vec3 f3d_indirect) {
  return (((f3d_direct + f3d_indirect) * s.occlusion) + s.emissive);
}

// `directional off`: every light the draw has but the
// directional ones, which always sit in its eight slots.
vec3 MaterialLights(Surface s) {
  vec3 total = vec3(0.0);
  int count = LightCount();
  for (int i = 0; i < kTotalLights; i++) {
    if (i >= count) break;
    if (i < kMaxLights && frag_info.light_position[i].w < 0.5) continue;
    LightSample light = SampleLight(i, s);
    if (light.n_dot_l <= 0.0) continue;
    light_transmittance = vec3(1.0);
    float visibility = LightHasShadow(i)
        ? LightVisibility(s, light, i) *
              PointShadowFactor(v_world_position, s.n, i)
        : 1.0;
    if (visibility <= 0.0) continue;
    total += ShadeLight(s, light) * light.radiance * light.n_dot_l * visibility * light_transmittance;
  }
  return total;
}

void main() {
  Surface s = ReadSurface();
  ApplyCommonMaps(s);
  vec3 f3d_direct = MaterialLights(s);
  vec3 f3d_lightmap = SampleLightmap();
  vec3 f3d_indirect = ShadeAmbient(s, f3d_lightmap);
  vec3 lit = ShadeComposite(s, f3d_direct, f3d_indirect);
  // Keeps what the engine binds to every lit stage; no frame
  // takes this branch.
  if (frag_info.frame_params.w < 0.0) {
    lit += f3d_direct + f3d_lightmap + s.ambient + s.emissive + vec3(s.occlusion);
  }
  float f3d_view_depth = ViewDepth();
  vec2 f3d_scene_uv = FragCoordFromTop(scene_depth_info.target.z) * scene_depth_info.target.xy;
  float f3d_stored = textureLod(scene_depth_texture, f3d_scene_uv, 0.0).a;
  float f3d_scene_depth = f3d_stored > 0.0 ? f3d_stored : 1000000.0;
  vec3 f3d_scene_position = Orthographic()
      ? v_world_position + fog_info.forward.xyz * (f3d_scene_depth - f3d_view_depth)
      : fog_info.eye.xyz + (v_world_position - fog_info.eye.xyz) * (f3d_scene_depth / max(f3d_view_depth, 1e-6));
  float facing = clamp(s.n_dot_v, 0.0, 1.0);
  float rim = pow((1.0 - facing), 3.0);
  float soft = clamp(((f3d_scene_depth - f3d_view_depth) * 4.0), 0.0, 1.0);
  vec4 result = vec4(((lit * (0.25 + (0.75 * facing))) + (material_params.rimColor * rim)), soft);
  WriteSurface(result.rgb, result.a);
}

--- vertex glsl
#version 460 core

// Generated from the vertex block of a material written in
// the material language, version 2. The source is the thing
// to edit. `mesh.vert` with the
// block between the engine's answer and the varyings.

in vec3 position;
in vec3 normal;
in vec2 texcoord;
in vec4 tangent;
in vec4 color;

#include <lib/morph.glsl>

uniform FrameInfo {
  mat4 mvp;
  mat4 model;
  mat4 normal_matrix;
}
frame_info;

// The view-projection alone, for a block that says where in
// the world the vertex is rather than where in the mesh.
uniform MaterialVertexInfo {
  mat4 view_projection;
}
material_vertex_info;

uniform MaterialParams {
  vec3 rimColor;
  float breath;
}
material_params;

out vec3 v_world_position;
out vec3 v_normal;
out vec2 v_texcoord;
out vec4 v_tangent;
out vec4 v_color;
out vec2 v_lightmap_uv;
out vec4 v_instance;

void main() {
  vec3 morphed_position = position;
  vec3 morphed_normal = normal;
  vec4 morphed_tangent = tangent;
  ApplyMorph(morphed_position, morphed_normal, morphed_tangent);
  vec4 f3d_instance = vec4(0.0);
  vec3 f3d_position = morphed_position;
  vec3 f3d_object_normal = morphed_normal;
  vec3 f3d_tangent = morphed_tangent.xyz;
  bool f3d_mirrored = determinant(mat3(frame_info.model)) < 0.0;
  vec3 f3d_world = (frame_info.model * vec4(f3d_position, 1.0)).xyz;
  vec3 f3d_normal = mat3(frame_info.normal_matrix) * f3d_object_normal;
  vec3 f3d_out_position = f3d_position;
  vec3 f3d_out_world = f3d_world;
  vec3 f3d_out_normal = f3d_normal;

  // The material's vertex block.
  f3d_out_world = (f3d_world + (f3d_normal * (0.02 * material_params.breath)));

  v_world_position = f3d_out_world;
  v_normal = f3d_out_normal;
  v_texcoord = texcoord;
  v_tangent = vec4(mat3(frame_info.model) * f3d_tangent,
                   f3d_mirrored ? -morphed_tangent.w : morphed_tangent.w);
  v_color = color;
  v_lightmap_uv = vec2(0.0);
  v_instance = f3d_instance;
  gl_Position = material_vertex_info.view_projection * vec4(f3d_out_world, 1.0);
}

--- vertex glsl RimGlowVertexSkinned
#version 460 core

// Generated from the vertex block of a material written in
// the material language, version 2. The source is the thing
// to edit. `mesh_skinned.vert` with the
// block between the engine's answer and the varyings.

in vec3 position;
in vec3 normal;
in vec2 texcoord;
in vec4 tangent;
in vec4 color;

#include <lib/morph.glsl>

in vec4 joints;
in vec4 weights;

uniform FrameInfo {
  mat4 mvp;
  mat4 model;
  mat4 normal_matrix;
}
frame_info;

#define kMaxJoints 64

uniform SkinInfo {
  mat4 joint_matrices[kMaxJoints];
}
skin_info;

int JointIndex(float joint) {
  return clamp(int(joint), 0, kMaxJoints - 1);
}

mat4 SkinMatrix() {
  float total = weights.x + weights.y + weights.z + weights.w;
  vec4 w = total > 1e-5 ? weights / total : vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
  return w.x * skin_info.joint_matrices[JointIndex(joints.x)] +
         w.y * skin_info.joint_matrices[JointIndex(joints.y)] +
         w.z * skin_info.joint_matrices[JointIndex(joints.z)] +
         w.w * skin_info.joint_matrices[JointIndex(joints.w)];
}

// The view-projection alone, for a block that says where in
// the world the vertex is rather than where in the mesh.
uniform MaterialVertexInfo {
  mat4 view_projection;
}
material_vertex_info;

uniform MaterialParams {
  vec3 rimColor;
  float breath;
}
material_params;

out vec3 v_world_position;
out vec3 v_normal;
out vec2 v_texcoord;
out vec4 v_tangent;
out vec4 v_color;
out vec2 v_lightmap_uv;
out vec4 v_instance;

void main() {
  vec3 morphed_position = position;
  vec3 morphed_normal = normal;
  vec4 morphed_tangent = tangent;
  ApplyMorph(morphed_position, morphed_normal, morphed_tangent);
  vec4 f3d_instance = vec4(0.0);
  mat4 skin = SkinMatrix();
  mat3 f3d_skin_rotation = mat3(skin);
  vec3 f3d_position = (skin * vec4(morphed_position, 1.0)).xyz;
  vec3 f3d_object_normal = f3d_skin_rotation * morphed_normal;
  vec3 f3d_tangent = f3d_skin_rotation * morphed_tangent.xyz;
  bool f3d_mirrored = (determinant(mat3(frame_info.model)) < 0.0) !=
                      (determinant(f3d_skin_rotation) < 0.0);
  vec3 f3d_world = (frame_info.model * vec4(f3d_position, 1.0)).xyz;
  vec3 f3d_normal = mat3(frame_info.normal_matrix) * f3d_object_normal;
  vec3 f3d_out_position = f3d_position;
  vec3 f3d_out_world = f3d_world;
  vec3 f3d_out_normal = f3d_normal;

  // The material's vertex block.
  f3d_out_world = (f3d_world + (f3d_normal * (0.02 * material_params.breath)));

  v_world_position = f3d_out_world;
  v_normal = f3d_out_normal;
  v_texcoord = texcoord;
  v_tangent = vec4(mat3(frame_info.model) * f3d_tangent,
                   f3d_mirrored ? -morphed_tangent.w : morphed_tangent.w);
  v_color = color;
  v_lightmap_uv = vec2(0.0);
  v_instance = f3d_instance;
  gl_Position = material_vertex_info.view_projection * vec4(f3d_out_world, 1.0);
}

--- vertex glsl RimGlowVertexInstanced
#version 460 core

// Generated from the vertex block of a material written in
// the material language, version 2. The source is the thing
// to edit. `mesh_instanced.vert` with the
// block between the engine's answer and the varyings.

in vec3 position;
in vec3 normal;
in vec2 texcoord;
in vec4 tangent;
in vec4 color;

#include <lib/morph_instanced.glsl>

#include <lib/instance_index.glsl>

in vec4 i_row0;
in vec4 i_row1;
in vec4 i_row2;
in vec4 i_color;
in vec4 i_data;

uniform FrameInfo {
  mat4 mvp;
  mat4 model;
  mat4 normal_matrix;
}
frame_info;

// The view-projection alone, for a block that says where in
// the world the vertex is rather than where in the mesh.
uniform MaterialVertexInfo {
  mat4 view_projection;
}
material_vertex_info;

uniform MaterialParams {
  vec3 rimColor;
  float breath;
}
material_params;

out vec3 v_world_position;
out vec3 v_normal;
out vec2 v_texcoord;
out vec4 v_tangent;
out vec4 v_color;
out vec2 v_lightmap_uv;
out vec4 v_instance;

void main() {
  vec3 morphed_position = position;
  vec3 morphed_normal = normal;
  vec4 morphed_tangent = tangent;
  ApplyMorphInstanced(F3dInstanceIndex(), morphed_position, morphed_normal, morphed_tangent);
  vec4 f3d_instance = i_data;
  mat4 f3d_instance_matrix = mat4(
      vec4(i_row0.x, i_row1.x, i_row2.x, 0.0),
      vec4(i_row0.y, i_row1.y, i_row2.y, 0.0),
      vec4(i_row0.z, i_row1.z, i_row2.z, 0.0),
      vec4(i_row0.w, i_row1.w, i_row2.w, 1.0));
  mat3 f3d_instance_rotation = mat3(f3d_instance_matrix);
  vec3 f3d_position = (f3d_instance_matrix * vec4(morphed_position, 1.0)).xyz;
  vec3 f3d_object_normal = normalize(f3d_instance_rotation * morphed_normal);
  vec3 f3d_tangent = f3d_instance_rotation * morphed_tangent.xyz;
  bool f3d_mirrored = (determinant(mat3(frame_info.model)) < 0.0) !=
                      (determinant(f3d_instance_rotation) < 0.0);
  vec3 f3d_world = (frame_info.model * vec4(f3d_position, 1.0)).xyz;
  vec3 f3d_normal = mat3(frame_info.normal_matrix) * f3d_object_normal;
  vec3 f3d_out_position = f3d_position;
  vec3 f3d_out_world = f3d_world;
  vec3 f3d_out_normal = f3d_normal;

  // The material's vertex block.
  f3d_out_world = (f3d_world + (f3d_normal * (0.02 * material_params.breath)));

  v_world_position = f3d_out_world;
  v_normal = f3d_out_normal;
  v_texcoord = texcoord;
  v_tangent = vec4(mat3(frame_info.model) * f3d_tangent,
                   f3d_mirrored ? -morphed_tangent.w : morphed_tangent.w);
  v_color = color * i_color;
  v_lightmap_uv = vec2(0.0);
  v_instance = f3d_instance;
  gl_Position = material_vertex_info.view_projection * vec4(f3d_out_world, 1.0);
}

== test/fixtures/v3/tube_light.f3dmat
name TubeLight v3 material inputs [albedo, alpha, lightKind, lightParams, lit, nDotL]
params [f3d_lighttype_tube:float=[-1.0] uniform MaterialParams]
textures []
fragment:
  return construct:vec4(input:lit:vec3, input:alpha:float)
light:
  let reach = call:clamp:float(binary:-:float(const:float[1.0], binary:*:float(swizzle:float[0](input:lightParams:vec4), const:float[0.1])), const:float[0.0], const:float[1.0])
  let engine = call:step:float(input:lightKind:float, const:float[15.5])
  return binary:*:vec3(binary:*:vec3(input:albedo:vec3, input:nDotL:float), call:mix:float(local:engine:float, local:reach:float, input:tube:float))
--- glsl
#version 460 core

// Generated from a material written in the material language
// — gfx-84n. The source is the thing to edit; this file is
// what the shader build compiles and what the three GPU
// backends translate. The software backend evaluates the same
// tree instead of reading this.
#include <lib/material_maps.glsl>
#include <lib/shadow.glsl>

uniform MaterialParams {
  float f3d_lighttype_tube;
}
material_params;

// The row of the light being shaded, which the material's
// loop sets before each call — version 3.
float f3d_light_kind = 0.0;
vec4 f3d_light_params = vec4(0.0);
float f3d_is_tube = 0.0;

// The material's light block, run once per light.
vec3 ShadeLight(Surface s, LightSample light) {
  float reach = clamp((1.0 - (f3d_light_params.x * 0.1)), 0.0, 1.0);
  float engine = step(f3d_light_kind, 15.5);
  return ((s.albedo * light.n_dot_l) * mix(engine, reach, f3d_is_tube));
}

float LightVisibility(Surface s, LightSample light, int i) {
  return ShadowFactor(s, light, i);
}

// A light's row, as `SampleLight` reads it: the slots, then the
// list, its cell's when the draw is clustered.
void F3dLightRow(int index, out vec4 position, out vec4 color,
                 out vec4 direction, out vec4 cone) {
  if (index < kMaxLights) {
    position = frag_info.light_position[index];
    color = frag_info.light_color[index];
    direction = frag_info.light_direction[index];
    cone = frag_info.light_cone[index];
    return;
  }
  int slot = index - kMaxLights;
  bool clustered = Clustered();
  float listRow = clustered ? ClusterRow(slot) : LightListRow(slot);
  float v = (listRow + 0.5) * light_list_info.list.z;
  float u = light_list_info.list.y;
  position = textureLod(light_list_texture, vec2(0.5 * u, v), 0.0);
  color = textureLod(light_list_texture, vec2(1.5 * u, v), 0.0);
  direction = textureLod(light_list_texture, vec2(2.5 * u, v), 0.0);
  cone = textureLod(light_list_texture, vec2(3.5 * u, v), 0.0);
  color.w *= clustered ? (InSlots(listRow) ? 0.0 : 1.0) : LightListScale(slot);
}

vec3 MaterialLights(Surface s) {
  vec3 total = vec3(0.0);
  int count = LightCount();
  for (int i = 0; i < kTotalLights; i++) {
    if (i >= count) break;
    vec4 row_position;
    vec4 row_color;
    vec4 row_direction;
    vec4 row_cone;
    F3dLightRow(i, row_position, row_color, row_direction, row_cone);
    f3d_light_kind = row_position.w;
    f3d_light_params = row_cone;
    f3d_is_tube = abs(f3d_light_kind - material_params.f3d_lighttype_tube) < 0.5 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    if (f3d_light_kind > 15.5) {
      LightSample own;
      own.integrated = 0.0;
      own.ltc = vec3(0.0);
      own.l = normalize(row_position.xyz - v_world_position);
      own.h = normalize(own.l + s.v);
      own.n_dot_l = max(dot(s.n, own.l), 0.0);
      own.n_dot_h = max(dot(s.n, own.h), 0.0);
      own.v_dot_h = max(dot(s.v, own.h), 0.0);
      own.radiance = row_color.rgb * row_color.w;
      if (own.n_dot_l <= 0.0) continue;
      total += ShadeLight(s, own) * own.radiance * own.n_dot_l;
      continue;
    }
    LightSample light = SampleLight(i, s);
    if (light.n_dot_l <= 0.0) continue;
    light_transmittance = vec3(1.0);
    float visibility = LightHasShadow(i)
        ? LightVisibility(s, light, i) *
              PointShadowFactor(v_world_position, s.n, i)
        : 1.0;
    if (visibility <= 0.0) continue;
    total += ShadeLight(s, light) * light.radiance * light.n_dot_l * visibility * light_transmittance;
  }
  return total;
}

void main() {
  Surface s = ReadSurface();
  ApplyCommonMaps(s);
  vec3 f3d_direct = MaterialLights(s);
  vec3 f3d_lightmap = SampleLightmap();
  vec3 f3d_indirect = s.albedo * (s.ambient + f3d_lightmap);
  vec3 lit = (f3d_direct + f3d_indirect) * s.occlusion + s.emissive;
  // Keeps what the engine binds to every lit stage; no frame
  // takes this branch.
  if (frag_info.frame_params.w < 0.0) {
    lit += f3d_direct + f3d_lightmap + s.ambient + s.emissive + vec3(s.occlusion);
  }
  vec4 result = vec4(lit, s.alpha);
  WriteSurface(result.rgb, result.a);
}

name Hatch v3 material inputs []
params [inkColor:vec3=[0.1, 0.1, 0.1] uniform MaterialParams, spacing:float=[4.0] uniform MaterialParams]
textures []
fragment:
  return construct:vec4(binary:*:vec3(param:inkColor:vec3, param:spacing:float), const:float[1.0])
--- glsl
#version 460 core

// Generated from a material written in the material language
// — gfx-84n. The source is the thing to edit; this file is
// what the shader build compiles and what the three GPU
// backends translate. The software backend evaluates the same
// tree instead of reading this.
#define F3D_NO_POINT_SHADOW
#define F3D_NO_LIGHT_LIST
#include <lib/surface.glsl>

uniform MaterialParams {
  vec3 inkColor;
  float spacing;
}
material_params;

// Never called: this material returns the light its surface
// emits rather than gathering any. The prototypes in
// surface.glsl still have to be satisfied.
vec3 ShadeLight(Surface s, LightSample light) {
  return s.albedo;
}

float LightVisibility(Surface s, LightSample light, int i) {
  return 1.0;
}

void main() {
  Surface s = ReadSurface();
  vec4 result = vec4((material_params.inkColor * material_params.spacing), 1.0);
  WriteSurface(result.rgb, result.a);
}
